# Matched-N Test Fixtures (Phase 4)

## Planned Synthetic Fixtures

This directory will contain synthetic bootstrap outputs for fast test runs.

### Design

- **2 synthetic loci** (one positive-control, one negative-control)
- **5 bootstraps** per locus (reduced from production 100 for test speed)
- **Deterministic seed** via config seed formula: `seed_base * trait_id + bootstrap_idx`

### Fixture Files (to be created in Plan 04-02/04-03)

```
fixtures/matched_n/
  locus_positive/
    bootstrap_1.fit.rds    # Synthetic SuSiE fit with PP.H4 > 0.8
    bootstrap_2.fit.rds
    ...
    bootstrap_5.fit.rds
  locus_negative/
    bootstrap_1.fit.rds    # Synthetic SuSiE fit with PP.H4 < 0.5
    ...
    bootstrap_5.fit.rds
  tier_assignments_synthetic.tsv
  manifest_synthetic.tsv
```

### Generation

Fixtures are generated by `tests/conftest.py` or a dedicated fixture
generator script, using numpy + scipy with fixed seeds for reproducibility.
The positive-control locus has effect sizes drawn from the empirical
Tier A distribution; the negative-control locus has near-zero effects.
